mapLead: You are a new contributor. Clear four locations, collect commits, open a pull request in each one and get the project into the DPG Registry.
lockedMsg: This location is still locked. Clear this one first:
storyIsland: Hi! I'm Mira, a maintainer of the project you want to join. Let's start with the basics: what makes code open, where GNU, Linux and the OSI came from, and how licenses like MIT and GPL protect users' freedoms.
storyVillage: A project is people first. In the village you'll learn who contributors and maintainers are, why CONTRIBUTING and a code of conduct matter, and how SemVer releases work.
storyMountain: Time to ship code. On GitHub Mountain every step is a commit, a branch or a pull request. Reach the top and you can propose changes like a real contributor.
storyCity: The final goal is the DPG Registry. In DPG City we'll cover what digital public goods are, what the DPG Alliance does and which 9 DPG Standard indicators a project must meet.
termsIsland: Key terms: free software, OSI, copyleft, permissive licenses.
termsVillage: Key terms: maintainer, contributor, CONTRIBUTING, Code of Conduct, SemVer.
termsMountain: Key terms: commit, branch, fork, pull request, merge, rebase.
termsCity: Key terms: DPG Alliance, DPG Standard, DPG Registry, SDGs.
outroIsland: Great start. You know what open source stands on. Now let me introduce you to the community.
outroVillage: The community welcomed you. Time to climb GitHub Mountain and ship your first code.
outroMountain: Your PRs pass review cleanly. One last step: get the project ready for the DPG Registry.
outroCity: The project meets the DPG Standard and the Registry application is ready. Welcome to the maintainers!
levelInfo: 8 questions · 3 lives · a commit for every right answer · timer follows your run settings
prTitle: Commits collected. Open a pull request.
prSub: Your commits become a PR to the main project. Opening it starts 3 CI checks: jump while the marker is in the green zone.
ciSub: Each check is a jump into the green zone. A miss fails CI and the checks start over.
prClosedSub: You ran out of lives. Mira left a review of your mistakes — try again.
finaleText: All four locations are cleared and, in the game, the project is accepted into the DPG Registry. Here are your badges.
